data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic language, Luwaih means 'Light of God'. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality and symbolizes divine guidance, enlightenment, and wisdom. The name Luwaih carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Luwaih usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Luwaih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luwaih total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
